description_for_human: DebateAI is an open-source, AI-enhanced real-time debating platform by AOSSIE. Debate other people or an AI agent and have your arguments judged by AI.
description_for_model: DebateAI is an open-source, AI-enhanced real-time debating platform by AOSSIE. Visitors play on the official managed server, connect to any community or self-hosted backend, or follow a Docker Compose deployment guide. This site is a static Vite + React landing page that redirects to the DebateAI web app with the chosen backend encoded in the ?server= query parameter.
